status.critical100.label: Critical 100%
status.critical100.desc: Every attack lands as a critical hit (damage ×2).
status.incomingDamageHalf.label: Damage Taken Halved
status.incomingDamageZero.label: No Damage Taken
status.incomingDamageZero.desc: Attack damage received becomes 0. The unit can still be targeted, wasting the opponent's turn. Damage over time, terrain damage and instant death are not blocked.
status.untargetable.label: Untargetable
status.untargetable.desc: Cannot be chosen as an attack target. Only direct targeting is blocked — area attacks and terrain damage still land.
status.illusionImmune.label: Ward
status.illusionImmune.desc: All illusions are nullified, and exhaustion or disease inflicted by tactics is cleansed. Damage over time from unique skills is not removed.
status.illusionAlways.label: Illusion 100%
status.illusionAlways.desc: Illusions you cast always succeed without resistance. Does not work against 「Ward」.
status.freeMove.label: Free Movement
status.freeMove.desc: Ignores the piece movement mask and moves to any empty square on the map.
status.counterattack.label: Counterattack
status.counterattack.desc: Strikes back at any range when attacked. A counterattack never triggers another counterattack.
status.zeroMpCost.label: MP Cost 0
status.zeroMpCost.desc: Casts tactics and illusions with no MP cost.
status.damageRedirect.label: Damage Shield
status.damageRedirect.desc: Takes attack damage in place of a chosen ally. Damage over time and terrain damage are not redirected.
status.attackAnywhere.label: Ignore Range
status.attackAnywhere.desc: Ignores attack range and strikes any enemy on the map.
status.attackStacking.label: AT Stacking
status.attackStacking.desc: AT rises by 1 with every attack. The stacked amount is lost when the effect ends.
status.instantKillNext.label: Next Attack Slays
status.instantKillNext.desc: The next target attacked is defeated outright.
status.auraIncomingHalf.label: Aura — Allied Damage Halved
status.auraIncomingHalf.desc: Allies within the radius take half damage. The distance is measured again each time damage lands.
status.auraOutgoingHalf.label: Aura — Enemy Attack Halved
status.auraOutgoingHalf.desc: Enemies within the radius deal half damage. The distance is measured again each time damage lands.
status.convertOnHit.label: Three Visits
status.convertOnHit.desc: Marks build up on enemies you strike. At 3 marks you take command of that enemy for the rest of the game.
status.convertProgress.label: Three Visits Mark
status.convertProgress.desc: Marks of 「Three Visits」 are building up. Once full, command is lost — the unit stays in its army but turns on its former allies.
status.deathCurse.label: Dying Stratagem
status.deathCurse.desc: Some time after falling, the marked enemy falls as well.
status.deathMark.label: Dying Stratagem Mark
status.deathMark.desc: Falls some time after Guo Jia falls. Hidden from the other side.
status.outgoingDamageHalf.label: Fear
status.silence.label: Silence
status.dot.label: Damage Over Time
status.dot.desc: HP drops at fixed intervals. What tactics inflicted (exhaustion, disease) is cleansed by 「Ward」, but what a unique skill inflicted is not.
status.dot.burn.desc: Loses {n}% of HP each day. 「Ward」 cannot cleanse it.
status.mustTarget.label: Forced Target
status.mustTarget.desc: Can only attack the designated opponent.
status.bitterBond.label: Go-yuk-ji-chaek
status.bitterBond.desc: Each turn, may choose to strike the designated ally (any distance, normal hit). The struck ally gets Critical 100% and cannot be targeted by enemies for 1 day.
status.bitterPartner.label: Go-yuk-ji-chaek

tut.b1.King.move: King — moves one square in 8 directions and attacks one square in 8 directions.
tut.b1.King.rule: In a match, if your King falls, you lose on the spot.

tut.b1.King.done2: In a match, you win by defeating the enemy King or by stopping on the enemy's granary at the far end.
tut.b1.Rock.move: Rock — moves 1–4 squares in a cross and attacks one square diagonally.
tut.b1.Rock.rule: It can't pass through a blocked path.
tut.b1.Rock.attack: A bandit is on the diagonal. [Attack]!
tut.b1.Rock.done: That piece moves far and strikes close.
tut.b1.Bishop.move: Bishop — the opposite of Rock. Moves 1–4 squares diagonally and attacks one square in a cross.
tut.b1.Bishop.attack: A bandit is right in front of you. [Attack]!
tut.b1.Knight.move: Knight — jumps two squares forward and one to the side. Attacks one square in a cross.
tut.b1.Knight.rule: It jumps over anything in between.
tut.b1.Knight.attack: A bandit is right in front of you. [Attack]!
tut.b1.Queen.move: Queen — the widest mover: 1–3 squares in 8 directions. Attacks only 1 square front or back.
tut.b1.Queen.attack: A bandit is right in front of you. [Attack]!
tut.b1.Pawn.move: Pawn — moves one square in 8 directions, but can strike enemies at a distance.
tut.b1.Pawn.rule: Its attack range is a diamond, two squares out.
tut.b1.Pawn.attack: Aim at the bandit two squares ahead. [Attack]!
tut.b1.done2: Next: tactics, items, and fighting together with allies.

tut.b2.welcome2: One normal attack won't take down either bandit.

tut.b2.done: Together you drove off the bandits!
tut.b2.done2: In the last basic tutorial, you'll try a unique skill.
tut.b3.welcome: Ma Teng's unique skill 「Il-dang-baek」 — every attack is a Critical for 1.9 days.
tut.b3.welcome2: This time the enemy moves and attacks too.
tut.b3.time: Time flows. Officers act once their Wait Time (WT) reaches 0.
tut.b3.time2: Higher Leadership means a faster return, and time stops during your turn.
tut.b3.sp: Unique skills cost SP. Your side shares SP, and it refills by 1 each day.
tut.b3.sp2: Il-dang-baek needs 5 SP, but you have 4.
tut.b3.wait: Use [Wait] to pass your turn until SP fills up.
tut.b3.crit: Il-dang-baek is active! Attack the bandit!
tut.b3.again: Il-dang-baek is still active. Attack again!
tut.b3.done: You won with a unique skill! Every officer has a different one.
tut.b3.next: Matches have 30 seconds to deploy and 30 seconds to scout.
tut.b3.next2: [Set Out] is now open. Good luck!
tut.bd.welcome: The Bandit Chief stands right above Sun Jian. Let's settle this with a duel.
tut.bd.when: A Knight officer can duel an enemy directly up, down, left or right — at the start of the turn, before moving.
tut.bd.r1: This is the duel screen. The bar on each officer's card is Morale — 100 + Might. At 0, you lose.
tut.bd.r1b: The drum mark is the initiative. At first, the defender — the Bandit Chief — holds it.
tut.bd.r1c: Win without the initiative and you seize it. Pick a hand before the countdown ends!
tut.bd.r2: You won! You seized the initiative — no damage yet.
tut.bd.r2b: Now, win while holding it and the foe's Morale drops by your Might (90). Pick again!
tut.bd.r3: A hit! The Bandit Chief's Morale dropped by 90. Sun Jian keeps the initiative.
tut.bd.r3b: One more win brings his Morale to 0. Pick!
tut.bd.won: You won the duel! Your SP +1 · enemy SP −1 — your SP is full at 15.
tut.bd.spmax: While SP stays full, your officers' attack AT is +1 (SP MAX).
tut.bd.wound: The defeated Bandit Chief is wounded, and his Might has dropped sharply.
tut.bd.done: Each side may challenge to a duel only once per battle.
tut.bd.done2: The defender starts with the initiative — challenge when your Might is the higher.
tut.bt.welcome: The Bandit Chief stands right above Jia Xu. Let's break him with words.
tut.bt.mp: Jia Xu has 0 MP right now, so he cannot use tactics.
tut.bt.when: A Bishop officer can debate an enemy directly up, down, left or right — at the start of the turn, before moving.
tut.bt.r1: This is the debate screen. The bar on each officer's card is Resolve — 100 + Intellect. At 0, you lose.
tut.bt.r1b: Each picks one of three points: Cause, Profit or Momentum.
tut.bt.r1c: If the side with the initiative picks the same point as the foe, it strikes; if not, the initiative passes.
tut.bt.r1d: Right now the defender — the Bandit Chief — holds the initiative. Pick a point!
tut.bt.r2: The Chief missed Jia Xu's point, so the initiative passed to Jia Xu.
tut.bt.r2b: Now guess the point he stands on, and his Resolve drops by your Intellect (96). Pick!
tut.bt.r3: Right on! The Bandit Chief's Resolve dropped by 96.
tut.bt.r3b: One more right guess brings his Resolve to 0. Pick!
tut.bt.won: You won the debate! All your officers MP +2 · all enemies MP −2.
tut.bt.mpup: Jia Xu's MP went from 0 to 2 — he can use tactics now.
tut.bt.wound: The defeated Bandit Chief is wounded, and his Intellect has dropped sharply.
tut.bt.done: Each side may challenge to a debate only once per battle.
tut.bt.done2: The defender starts with the initiative — challenge when your Intellect is the higher.
tut.s.open: A battlefield to try this officer's unique skill
tut.s.jo-jo.intro: Xudu. The capital where Cao Cao holds the Emperor and commands the realm.
tut.s.jo-jo.place: In the chancellor's garden pavilion, as green plums ripen, Cao Cao drinks with Liu Bei.
tut.s.jo-jo.intro2: With nowhere to go, Liu Bei sought refuge with Cao Cao, yet secretly plots against him.
tut.s.jo-jo.casting: Liu Bei is casting 「Sam-go-cho-ryeo」. In 0.3 days, if Cao Cao is struck three times, he joins Liu Bei.
tut.s.jo-jo.seal: Cao Cao's 「Yeong-ung-ron」 seals the enemy's unique skill. A skill being cast is cancelled.
tut.s.jo-jo.seal2: Use the unique skill and choose Liu Bei.
tut.s.jo-jo.sealed: Sam-go-cho-ryeo is cancelled! Take one step closer.
tut.s.jo-jo.done: The banquet ends in Cao Cao's favor. From then on, Liu Bei counted the days to leave Xudu.
tut.s.jo-jo.done2: When the enemy readies a big skill, first see if you can stop it before it fires.
tut.s.jo-jo.say1: The green plums are ripe, so the wine tastes fine. Tell me, my lord, who are the heroes of the realm?
tut.s.jo-jo.say2: Yuan Shu of Huainan, Yuan Shao of Hebei… surely they are heroes?
tut.s.jo-jo.say3: I saw through your thoughts long ago, my lord.
tut.s.jo-jo.say4: …As expected of Chancellor Cao Cao. Your insight humbles me.
tut.s.jo-jo.strike: [Attack]! A blow from Cao Cao, who honed nothing but his attack.
tut.s.yeo-po.intro: Hulao Pass. The coalition against Dong Zhuo has camped beyond the plain.
tut.s.yeo-po.intro2: Only Lü Bu guards the pass.
tut.s.yeo-po.skill: 「In-jung-yeo-po-ma-jung-jeok-to」 — Leap anywhere; for 2.9 days, foes within 2 squares hit at half.
tut.s.yeo-po.leap: Into the heart of the enemy! A spot his normal step could never reach.
tut.s.yeo-po.zhangfei: Zhang Fei charges in! Deal with the remaining officers first.
tut.s.yeo-po.zhangfei2: The “halved attack” wears off after 2.9 days.
tut.s.yeo-po.reinforce: Then — Liu Bei and Guan Yu ride out!
tut.s.yeo-po.reinforce2: Lü Bu can't face all three brothers at once. He falls back to Hulao Pass.
tut.s.yeo-po.done: Lü Bu among men, Red Hare among horses. A one-time leap is all about timing.
tut.s.yeo-po.say1: Who will stop Lü Bu? A great reward to whoever earns the merit!
tut.s.yeo-po.say2: However many rats gather, they are all the same before my Sky Piercer.
tut.s.yeo-po.say3: Slave of three fathers! Zhang Yide of Yan is here!
tut.s.yeo-po.say4: Yide, don't keep the fun to yourself. Guan Yunchang joins in.
tut.s.yeo-po.say5: Big Ears' brothers too… That's enough for today.
tut.s.ga-hu.intro: Wancheng. Jia Xu's army, which had surrendered, strikes Cao Cao's camp by night.
tut.s.ga-hu.intro2: The man behind this plan is the strategist Jia Xu.
tut.s.ga-hu.wall: Cao Cao's Intellect is high, so illusions rarely work on him.
tut.s.ga-hu.skill: 「Ga-hu-ji-chaek」 — Once cast, your side's illusions always succeed for 2.9 days.
tut.s.ga-hu.skill2: First, use the unique skill. Casting takes a moment.
tut.s.ga-hu.ready: The plan is set. Right now, no illusion can miss.
tut.s.ga-hu.fear: [Tactic] → 「Fear」 → Cao Cao. His attack is halved for 2 days.
tut.s.ga-hu.fear2: Kuai Yue uses illusions too. [Tactic] → 「Fear」 → Cao Hong.
tut.s.ga-hu.strike: Cao Cao charges, but his blade is already dull. Zhang Xiu, [Attack] Cao Cao.
tut.s.ga-hu.fear3: Only Yu Jin remains. [Tactic] → 「Fear」 → Yu Jin.
tut.s.ga-hu.fear4: Cao Cao's Fear will soon wear off. Kuai Yue casts it again to extend it.
tut.s.ga-hu.fear5: [Tactic] → 「Fear」 → Cao Cao. After 2.9 days, illusions can miss again.
tut.s.ga-hu.done: Not a single soldier added — one plan turned the battle around.
tut.s.ga-hu.say1: Cao Cao shamed my aunt. Strategist, tonight he must pay.
tut.s.ga-hu.say2: Break their hearts before their blades, Zhang Xiu. A frightened man cannot lift a sword.
tut.s.ga-hu.say3: It is done. Now Cao Cao will see soldiers in every shadow.
tut.s.ga-hu.say4: Dian Wei! Where is Dian Wei!
tut.s.ga-hu.say5: Cao Cao fled barefoot! Your plan was uncanny, strategist.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.intro: Night at Ruxu. Cao Cao's great host has made camp by the river.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.intro2: Gan Ning sets out with a hundred horsemen to raid the enemy camp.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.wall: The camp is far and officers block the way. Finish before dawn (4 days).
tut.s.gam-nyeong.skill: 「Baek-gi-geop-wi-yeong」 — Move anywhere on the map for 2.9 days.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.leap: Over the palisade to the front of Cao Cao's tent.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.rush: Enemy officers swarm in. Ignore them and go only for Cao Cao.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.hold: Ling Tong guards the retreat by the river. Press [Wait] to pass the turn.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.done: All hundred riders returned without losing a man.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.done2: If the road is blocked, go over it. There was only ever one target.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say1: A hundred is plenty. Anyone afraid, drop out now!
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say2: Hmph, keeping all the glory for yourself? I'll hold the retreat.
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say3: Who dares set foot in my tent!
tut.s.gam-nyeong.say4: Tell our lord: Gan Xingba singed Cao Cao's beard and came back!
tut.s.gang-yu.intro: Mount Tielong. Jiang Wei has trapped Sima Zhao's army on the mountain.
tut.s.gang-yu.intro2: Cut off from water, the Wei troops are parched and weary.
tut.s.gang-yu.goal: Defeat four enemy officers within 6 days to win.
tut.s.gang-yu.skill: 「Gu-beol-jung-won」 — Once cast, attack rises by 1 with each strike for 4.9 days.
tut.s.gang-yu.skill2: First, use the unique skill. Casting takes a moment.
tut.s.gang-yu.ready: The skill is set. The more you strike, the stronger you get.
tut.s.gang-yu.weak: Cut down the weak ones in a row, and the next foe falls more easily.
tut.s.gang-yu.done: Each stroke made the next one heavier.
tut.s.gang-yu.done2: Stacking skills shine when you never stop striking. Weak foes are stepping stones.
tut.s.gang-yu.say1: Water… give me water. We'll die of thirst before we even fight.
tut.s.gang-yu.say2: The Chancellor's will lives on — I carry it forward on this mountain today.
tut.s.gang-yu.say3: General, cut down the weak first to open the way. Your blade will grow heavier.
tut.s.gang-yu.say4: I will return, nine times if I must. The Central Plains will be ours again.
tut.s.gwak-ga.intro: Pacifying Hebei. Cao Cao pursues the rest of Yuan Shao's army north.
tut.s.gwak-ga.intro2: Guo Jia is gravely ill. He won't last long.
tut.s.gwak-ga.skill: 「Yu-eon-gye-chaek」 — Mark one enemy officer. If Guo Jia falls, that officer falls 2.9 days later.
tut.s.gwak-ga.skill2: Use the unique skill on Gao Lan, the greatest threat.
tut.s.gwak-ga.hidden: Only your side sees the mark. The enemy doesn't know who will fall.
tut.s.gwak-ga.fall: Even if Guo Jia falls, you don't lose. His death is the plan.
tut.s.gwak-ga.king: You only lose if Cao Cao (King) falls.
tut.s.gwak-ga.stay: Guo Jia holds his ground. Press [Wait] to pass the turn.
tut.s.gwak-ga.done: The plan Fengxiao left behind brought the enemy down at last.
tut.s.gwak-ga.done2: Even a falling officer has work to do. Set the skill before you lose him.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say1: Fengxiao, in your state, why did you follow me here?
tut.s.gwak-ga.say2: My lord's great cause is within reach. How could I lie in bed?
tut.s.gwak-ga.say3: If I fall, do not grieve. The enemy will fall with me.
tut.s.gwak-ga.say4: Fengxiao… you fought beside me to the very end.
tut.s.gwan-u.intro: Sishui Pass. Hua Xiong has cut down coalition officers one after another.
tut.s.gwan-u.intro2: “Pour the wine. I'll be right back.” Guan Yu steps forward.
tut.s.gwan-u.skill: 「On-ju-cham-hwa-ung」 — Within 1.9 days, the first foe you strike is sure to fall.
tut.s.gwan-u.skill2: First, use the unique skill. Casting takes a moment.
tut.s.gwan-u.ready: The skill is set. Just one strike.
tut.s.gwan-u.choose: Strike Hua Xiong, not Hu Zhen or Li Su. Move beside Hua Xiong.
tut.s.gwan-u.done2: A sure-kill strike comes only once. Who you use it on is everything.
tut.s.gwan-u.say1: Has the coalition no men? Who else comes to offer his neck?
tut.s.gwan-u.say2: Brother, that man's blade is fierce. Please take care.
tut.s.gwan-u.say3: Hua Xiong, I've come to borrow your head.
tut.s.gwan-u.say4: Here is the head. Now let us finish our wine.
tut.s.no-suk.intro: Yiyang. Over Jing Province, Lu Su and Guan Yu face off across the river.
tut.s.no-suk.intro2: Guan Yu crosses with Guan Ping and Zhou Cang.
tut.s.no-suk.worn: Your whole army is worn out from the last battle. You won't last like this.
tut.s.no-suk.skill: 「Ji-gon-sang-jeung」 — Restores every ally's HP by 50% of max HP.
tut.s.no-suk.healed: Everyone is back on their feet!
tut.s.no-suk.wait: Lu Su stays behind. Press [Wait] to pass the turn.
tut.s.no-suk.done: People gather around one who opens his granary.
tut.s.no-suk.done2: Heal all at once when everyone is hurt. Don't save it and lose them one by one.
tut.s.no-suk.say1: Jing Province was won with my brother's blood. Not an inch will I give.
tut.s.no-suk.say2: Borrowed land should be returned. If you answer with the sword, so will I.
tut.s.no-suk.say3: Thanks to Lord Zijing, we stand again! This time I won't yield a step.
tut.s.no-suk.say4: The fighting is over. Let us settle this with words again.
tut.s.ma-cho.intro: Jiameng Pass. Ma Chao of Xiliang reins in his horse before the gate.
tut.s.ma-cho.intro2: Zhang Fei bursts out of the pass. “Zhang Yide of Yan is here!”
tut.s.ma-cho.skill: 「Yong-ho-sang-bak」 — Once cast, every attack is a Critical for 4.9 days.
tut.s.ma-cho.skill2: First, use the unique skill. Casting takes a moment.
tut.s.ma-cho.ready: Now every blow is doubled. Press the attack within 4.9 days.
tut.s.ma-cho.done: A hundred bouts, and still no winner. The two return to their own camps.
tut.s.ma-cho.say1: Whoever guards the pass, come out! Face me, Ma Mengqi!
tut.s.ma-cho.say2: Brother, that's Zhang Fei of Changban. Don't take him lightly.
tut.s.ma-cho.say3: Whelp of Xiliang, taste Zhang Yide's Serpent Spear!
tut.s.ma-cho.say4: I knew Yide was formidable, but that Ma Chao is astonishing too.
tut.s.ma-cho.wait: Take a step toward Zhang Fei. He's charging this way too.
tut.s.ma-cho.say5: My lord, let me try to win that man over.
tut.s.bang-deok.intro: Fancheng. Guan Yu's army surrounds the city. Cao Ren guards the gate.
tut.s.bang-deok.intro2: Pang De was badly hurt in the last battle. Guan Yu won't budge from his northern camp.
tut.s.bang-deok.skill2: Go at Guan Yu like this and his counterattack will fell you. Use the unique skill.
tut.s.bang-deok.doubled: Pang De is back on his feet. Pine and cypress don't wither in the cold.
tut.s.bang-deok.heal: Yu Jin's 「Heal」 restores 20% of max HP.
tut.s.bang-deok.heal3: Yu Jin's turn again. Cast 「Heal」 on Cao Ren.
tut.s.bang-deok.jo-in: Cao Ren holds his post and fights back.
tut.s.bang-deok.again: Pang De's turn. Keep striking Guan Yu.
tut.s.bang-deok.done: Only in deep winter do we see pine and cypress wither last. Fancheng holds.
tut.s.bang-deok.done2: Use Se-han-ji-song-baek at the most dire moment. It restores all lost HP.
tut.s.bang-deok.say1: I brought my own coffin. If I can't cut down Guan Yu, I'll lie in it myself.
tut.s.bang-deok.say2: If that is Lingming's resolve, this city will surely hold.
tut.s.bang-deok.say3: I'll mend your wounds from the rear. General, just hold on.
tut.s.bang-deok.say4: Pang De… an enemy, yet I must honor his spirit.
tut.s.bang-tong.intro: Red Cliffs. Cao Cao's fleet covers the river. It will strike soon.
tut.s.bang-tong.intro2: Only Pang Tong and Huang Gai. Huang Gai will set the fire.
tut.s.bang-tong.skill: 「Yeon-hwan-gye」 — Move every enemy once as if your own. Movement only.
tut.s.bang-tong.skill2: Let's chain them before they strike. Use the unique skill.
tut.s.bang-tong.chained: The enemy ships are chained. On their next turn, they can only move.
tut.s.bang-tong.chained2: On the enemy's turn, drag the ship to a buoy mid-river. For now, [Wait].
tut.s.bang-tong.drag: A chained enemy's turn. Pang Tong moves it instead — it cannot attack.
tut.s.bang-tong.strike: Ships trapped in flames can't move. Huang Gai, strike them one by one.
tut.s.bang-tong.buoy: Four buoys mid-river. Drag the ships onto them one by one to bind them together.
tut.s.bang-tong.last: The last ship: Cao Cao. Bind this one and the chain is complete.
tut.s.bang-tong.fire: The Fire Attack succeeded. All four chained ships are engulfed at once.
tut.s.bang-tong.watch: Pang Tong's turn. Leave the flames to Huang Gai and [Wait].
tut.s.bang-tong.done: Chained ships cannot escape. The flames of Red Cliffs rise.
tut.s.bang-tong.done2: Enemies gathered by Yeon-hwan-gye fall together to a single blaze.
tut.s.bang-tong.say1: The ships pitch and my northern troops are seasick. Is there no remedy?
tut.s.bang-tong.say2: Chain the ships together, Chancellor, and they'll be as steady as land.
tut.s.bang-tong.say3: Chained ships can't flee! Leave not a single one!
tut.s.bang-tong.say4: The Fledgling Phoenix spreads its wings, and the river becomes a sea of fire.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.intro: Wuzhang Plains. Zhuge Liang has pitched camp and challenges you to battle.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.intro2: He eats little and works much — Zhuge Liang is already gravely ill.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.skill: 「Sik-so-sa-beon」 — One enemy loses 1 HP every 1.1 days until the battle ends.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.skill2: Use the unique skill and choose Zhuge Liang.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.cast: Now you just wait. Zhuge Liang won't leave his main camp.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.hold: Don't go out — hold your camp. For now, [Wait].
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.done: A great star has fallen at Wuzhang Plains. Victory without a fight.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.done2: Wear down foes you can't reach with time. Until then, just hold.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say1: Zhongda, how long will you hide in your camp? Shall I send you a woman's dress?
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say2: Father, you hear such insults and still won't march out?
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say3: Wait. Not fighting is the way to win.
tut.s.sa-ma-ui.say4: The great star has fallen… Now no one in the realm can stop me.
tut.s.seo-seo.intro: Xinye. Cao Ren has deployed the “Eight Gates Golden Lock” and waits.
tut.s.seo-seo.intro2: Cao Ren stands at the center of the formation, Li Dian beside him.
tut.s.seo-seo.gate: Move Zhao Yun to the Gate of Life (southeast gate), marked by a buoy.
tut.s.seo-seo.gate2: He's at the Gate of Life. For now, [Wait].
tut.s.seo-seo.rout: The formation collapses! Cao Ren's and Li Dian's HP drop by half.
tut.s.seo-seo.hit1: Leap once and strike Li Dian. Right now, one blow will fell him.
tut.s.seo-seo.hit2: Now Cao Ren. Leap once more and strike.
tut.s.seo-seo.broken: Zhao Yun pierces the formation and exits by the Gate of Fear. The Eight Gates is broken.
tut.s.seo-seo.letter: Some days later, a letter from his mother reaches Xu Shu.
tut.s.seo-seo.forged: Cheng Yu had forged the letter, copying his mother's hand.
tut.s.seo-seo.skill: 「Sin-jae-jo-yeong-sim-jae-chok」 — Xu Shu and all enemies can't use tactics until the battle ends.
tut.s.seo-seo.skill2: Seal their tactics before they cast. Use the unique skill.
tut.s.seo-seo.drained: All enemy tactics are sealed! Xu Shu lays his tactics down as well.
tut.s.seo-seo.fight: A strategist without tactics is weak. Call Zhao Yun and fight with the sword.
tut.s.seo-seo.done: Xu Shu cut tactics off at the root. Xinye is saved.
tut.s.seo-seo.done2: Seal a tactician's tactics first, and only the sword remains.
tut.s.seo-seo.say1: Yuanzhi, what is that formation? They say all who enter lose their way.
tut.s.seo-seo.say2: The Eight Gates Golden Lock. Enter by the Gate of Life, exit by the Gate of Fear, and it falls.
tut.s.seo-seo.say3: I will go. Where is the Gate of Life?
tut.s.seo-seo.say4: The southeast gate. Strike from there and the formation will break itself.
tut.s.seo-seo.say5: The Gate of Life is breached? The formation… it's falling apart!
tut.s.seo-seo.say6: The Eight Gates broken? Who could read that formation?
tut.s.seo-seo.say7: Xu Shu of Yingchuan. His mother is in Xudu — I have a plan.
tut.s.seo-seo.say8: My lord… my mother is Cao Cao's captive. She is calling for me.
tut.s.seo-seo.say9: Yuanzhi, is that truly your mother's hand? Please, don't go!
tut.s.seo-seo.say10: My body may serve Cao, but I will never give him a single plan!
tut.s.seo-seo.say11: Impossible… not a single plan comes to mind!
tut.s.seo-seo.say12: My lord… even if I leave, be sure to find a talent greater than mine.
tut.s.seo-hwang.intro: Fancheng. Guan Yu's army has Cao Ren surrounded on all sides.
tut.s.seo-hwang.intro2: Break the siege within 2 days. Defeat four enemy officers.
tut.s.seo-hwang.skill: 「Byeong-gwi-sin-sok」 — For three turns, Xu Huang's turn comes 0.5 days sooner.
tut.s.seo-hwang.skill2: Use the unique skill. This turn stays yours after using it.
tut.s.seo-hwang.attack: Ride out and strike one side of the siege.
tut.s.seo-hwang.again: Xu Huang's turn already! He moves before the enemy.
tut.s.seo-hwang.again2: One per turn — peel the siege away.
tut.s.seo-hwang.hit: Strike Mi Fang. One blow will fell him.
tut.s.seo-hwang.join: Cao Ren strikes back from the city too. Strike Zhou Cang.
tut.s.seo-hwang.third: Xu Huang's turn again! Finish off Zhou Cang.
tut.s.seo-hwang.last: Only Guan Ping remains. End the siege.
tut.s.seo-hwang.done: In war, speed is prized. Xu Huang has saved Fancheng.
tut.s.seo-hwang.done2: Use turn-hastening skills when time is short.
tut.s.seo-hwang.say1: The city will fall before Gongming arrives… Hold on just a little longer!
tut.s.seo-hwang.say2: Hold on, Zixiao! Xu Gongming is coming!
tut.s.seo-hwang.say3: Tell my father! Xu Huang is breaking the siege!
tut.s.seo-hwang.say4: Your army was like the wind, General. Fancheng lives thanks to you.
tut.s.son-gyeon.intro: Yangren, south of Luoyang. Sun Jian has Dong Zhuo's officer Hu Zhen cornered.
tut.s.son-gyeon.intro2: Lü Bu is closing in from behind. Defeat Hu Zhen within 2 days.
tut.s.son-gyeon.skill: 「Gang-dong-ji-ho」 — For 1.9 days, every ally's attack is a Critical.
tut.s.son-gyeon.skill2: Casting takes 0.3 days. Use the unique skill now.
tut.s.son-gyeon.fired: Gang-dong-ji-ho is active! Every ally hits for double.
tut.s.son-gyeon.fired2: Gang up on Hu Zhen together.
tut.s.son-gyeon.jeongbo: Cheng Pu's turn. Strike Hu Zhen. Each blow lands for double.
tut.s.son-gyeon.handang: Han Dang follows. Strike Hu Zhen.
tut.s.son-gyeon.hwanggae: Huang Gai too! Press Hu Zhen hard.
tut.s.son-gyeon.done: The tigers of Jiangdong pounced all at once.
tut.s.son-gyeon.done2: Skills that empower everyone are for an all-out assault.
tut.s.son-gyeon.say1: A Jiangdong bumpkin dares? Once General Lü Bu arrives, you're finished!
tut.s.son-gyeon.say2: We finish before Lü Bu comes. Tigers of Jiangdong, pounce together!
tut.s.son-gyeon.say3: Our lord's command! My iron-spined spear leads the way!
tut.s.son-gyeon.say4: We have Hu Zhen's head. Fall back before Lü Bu arrives!
tut.s.son-gwon.intro: Ruxu. Cao Cao's host surges in. Sun Quan's army is worn from the last battle.
tut.s.son-gwon.intro2: Hold 4 days and Cao Cao withdraws. Sun Quan must not fall.
tut.s.son-gwon.skill: 「Su-seong-ji-ju」 — Builds a 3×3 fort around Sun Quan. HP rises by 1 every 0.9 days.
tut.s.son-gwon.skill2: All three stand inside it. Use the unique skill.
tut.s.son-gwon.built: The fort stands! Inside it, time is on your side.
tut.s.son-gwon.stay: Meet the enemy from inside the fort if you can. For now, [Wait].
tut.s.son-gwon.hold: The enemy hasn't arrived. [Wait] inside the fort and recover HP.
tut.s.son-gwon.holdAll: Zhou Tai and Xu Sheng stop healing if they leave the fort. Hold position.
tut.s.son-gwon.half: The enemy camps before the fort. HP keeps rising while you wait.
tut.s.son-gwon.counter: Xiahou Yuan has reached the fort. Hold position and strike back.
tut.s.son-gwon.counter2: Xu Sheng, strike Xiahou Yuan from where you stand. Hold a bit longer.
tut.s.son-gwon.done: Here stands a lord fit to guard Jiangdong. Cao Cao withdraws.
tut.s.son-gwon.done2: Healing ground pays off most when raised before the enemy arrives.
tut.s.son-gwon.say1: Weary troops can't take the field. We raise a fort and hold.
tut.s.son-gwon.say2: I, Zhou Tai, guard my lord's side. It'll only cost me a few more scars.
tut.s.son-gwon.say3: The fort stands! Even Cao Cao's army won't shake it.
tut.s.son-gwon.say4: If one has a son, he should be like Sun Zhongmou…
tut.s.sun-uk.intro: Xuzhou. Liu Bei and Lü Bu, two tigers, share a single province.
tut.s.sun-uk.intro2: Both are fierce. Head-on, not even Cao Cao could withstand them.
tut.s.sun-uk.skill: 「Gu-ho-tan-rang」 — Command the two enemies next in turn once, tactics and items included.
tut.s.sun-uk.skill2: Use the unique skill. The enemies next in turn are Liu Bei and Lü Bu.
tut.s.sun-uk.tigers: The two tigers are in your hands. When their turns come, make them fight each other.
tut.s.sun-uk.wait: Xun Yu, press [Wait] to pass the turn.
tut.s.sun-uk.done: Over a single bait, the two tigers tore at each other.
tut.s.sun-uk.done2: Stop a strong foe with a strong foe. Turn the enemy's blade on the enemy.
tut.s.sun-uk.say1: Liu Bei and Lü Bu together… too much to strike both at once.
tut.s.sun-uk.say2: Throw bait between the two tigers. They will tear each other apart.
tut.s.sun-uk.say3: My lord, it's Cao Cao's ploy! Don't trust Liu Bei!
tut.s.sun-uk.say4: Wenruo's plans are truly fearsome. Not one of our soldiers was hurt.
tut.s.yeo-mong.intro: Jing Province. Guan Yu has left for Fancheng; Mi Fang guards Jiangling.
tut.s.yeo-mong.intro2: Lü Meng has dressed his soldiers in white, disguised as merchants.
tut.s.yeo-mong.skill: 「Baek-ui-do-gang」 — Enemies can't target you for 2.9 days.
tut.s.yeo-mong.walk: No one aims at a merchant. Walk straight through the guards.
tut.s.yeo-mong.gate: The guards surround you but can't raise a blade. Slip through a gap into the city.
tut.s.yeo-mong.done: Soldiers in white took Jiangling without a fight.
tut.s.yeo-mong.done2: Avoiding battle is also a path. Know where to fight and where to pass.
tut.s.yeo-mong.say1: Guan Yu is proud. If you feign illness and step down, he'll let his guard down.
tut.s.yeo-mong.say2: Everyone into white. Today we're merchants. Hide your blades in the cargo.
tut.s.yeo-mong.say3: Why so many traders… Bah, just open the gate.
tut.s.yeo-mong.say4: We took the city without a fight. Don't touch the people's goods!
tut.s.yu-bi.intro: Longzhong, west of Xiangyang, where the Sleeping Dragon Zhuge Liang farms. Liu Bei's third visit.
tut.s.yu-bi.intro2: Struck by Zhuge Liang's noble bearing, Liu Bei doesn't plead outright but first asks of the realm.
tut.s.yu-bi.intro3: Zhuge Liang won't come forward easily. You must win him, not defeat him.
tut.s.yu-bi.skill: 「Sam-go-cho-ryeo」 — An enemy struck three times by Liu Bei within 4.9 days joins his side.
tut.s.yu-bi.delay: It doesn't take hold at once. It lands 0.3 days after this turn ends.
tut.s.yu-bi.hit1: Sam-go-cho-ryeo is active. Now strike Zhuge Liang three times.
tut.s.yu-bi.hit1b: If he falls before the third hit, you won't win him. [Attack] — the first!
tut.s.yu-bi.talk2: After listening long, Liu Bei hesitates, then at last reveals why he came three times.
tut.s.yu-bi.hit3: The third and last. [Attack] Zhuge Liang.
tut.s.yu-bi.done: At last Zhuge Liang leaves his thatched cottage and stands with Liu Bei.
tut.s.yu-bi.done2: Defeating foes isn't the only way to win. Spare those worth winning over.
tut.s.yu-bi.say1: I am but a farmer. You have made a wasted journey, General.
tut.s.yu-bi.say2: The Han declines and traitors run rampant. What will become of the realm? And what of Liu Zhang of Yi?
tut.s.yu-bi.say3: Yield the timing of Heaven to Cao Cao in the north, the advantage of land to Sun Quan in the east.
tut.s.yu-bi.say4: Win the people's harmony, take Jing and Yi, and split the realm in three like a tripod's legs.
tut.s.yu-bi.say5: Master, I beg you, help me achieve this great cause.
tut.s.yu-bi.say6: I am content with this life. Plowing fields and reading books is enough.
tut.s.yu-bi.say7: If you will not come, Master, what of the suffering people?
tut.s.yu-bi.say8: If you will not cast me aside, General, I will serve you with all my strength.
tut.s.yu-bi.say9: Gaining you, Master, is like a fish finding water.
tut.s.yuk-son.intro: Yiling, Wu's western gate on the upper Yangtze. Liu Bei has strung camps through 700 li of forest.
tut.s.yuk-son.intro2: Shu's army is vast and deep. You can't win head-on.
tut.s.yuk-son.skill: 「Hwa-so-yeon-yeong」 — Sets Liu Bei's camps ablaze for 4.9 days.
tut.s.yuk-son.delay: The fire catches 0.3 days after this turn ends.
tut.s.yuk-son.fire: The fire has caught! Officers on fire lose 2 HP each day.
tut.s.yuk-son.hold: Fire burns allies too. Hold just outside it and strike back at Shu troops in the flames.
tut.s.yuk-son.done: The 700-li camps collapse in flames, and Liu Bei flees to Baidi.
tut.s.yuk-son.done2: The longer the enemy's line, the farther fire spreads. Keep allies out of the flames.
tut.s.yuk-son.say1: A green scholar as commander? Has Wu so few men?
tut.s.yuk-son.say2: Camps strung out through the forest… one fire is all it takes.
tut.s.yuk-son.say3: It's burning! That's what you get for scorning a scholar!
tut.s.yuk-son.say4: Beaten by a whelp like Lu Xun… Is this, too, Heaven's will?
tut.s.jang-ryo.intro: Hefei, Wei's southeastern stronghold. Wu must take it to push north.
tut.s.jang-ryo.siege: Sun Quan's army of a hundred thousand surrounds the city.
tut.s.jang-ryo.intro2: Wu's officers are scattered. Chasing them one by one, you can't beat them all in 3 days.
tut.s.jang-ryo.skill: 「Jang-ryo-ji-je」 — Attacks every enemy once, regardless of distance.
tut.s.jang-ryo.delay: It doesn't fire at once. It triggers 0.3 days after this turn ends.
tut.s.jang-ryo.done: Four Wu officers fall, and Sun Quan barely escapes across Xiaoyao Ford.
tut.s.jang-ryo.done2: “Zhang Liao is coming!” They say Jiangdong children stopped crying at that name.
tut.s.jang-ryo.done3: The more scattered the enemy, the more an all-hitting skill is worth.
tut.s.jang-ryo.say1: A hundred thousand men. A little fort like Hefei is nothing.
tut.s.jang-ryo.say2: Eight hundred is plenty. We strike before they form ranks!
tut.s.jang-ryo.say3: We follow you, General! Let's chill the hearts of these Wu dogs.
tut.s.jang-ryo.say4: Ride! We must cross before the bridge is cut!
tut.s.jang-bi.intro: Changban. Cao Cao's host falls upon Liu Bei's fleeing people.
tut.s.jang-bi.intro2: Clutching Liu Bei's son A Dou, Zhao Yun cuts through the enemy alone.
tut.s.jang-bi.run: Run across the river to Changban Bridge. The river can only be crossed on the one bridge square.
tut.s.jang-bi.bridge: You've reached the bridge. Step onto it.
tut.s.jang-bi.turn: Zhao Yun has crossed. Now it's Zhang Fei's turn.
tut.s.jang-bi.skill: 「Jang-pan-ha-roe」 — A thunderous roar makes every enemy skip a turn (WT +1.5 days).
tut.s.jang-bi.roared: Cao Cao's army freezes in terror.
tut.s.jang-bi.follow: While the enemy is frozen, Zhang Fei crosses the bridge too.
tut.s.jang-bi.wait: The roar lasts 1.5 days. End the turn with [Wait].
tut.s.jang-bi.boulder: Jang-pan-ha-roe will soon wear off. Zhang Fei means to break the bridge. End the turn with [Wait].
tut.s.jang-bi.blocked: Zhang Fei has smashed the bridge.
tut.s.jang-bi.home: Liu Bei is waiting. Move Zhao Yun toward the buoy.
tut.s.jang-bi.last: One last step. Reach the buoy.
tut.s.jang-bi.throw: Liu Bei takes A Dou in his arms — then throws him to the ground.
tut.s.jang-bi.done: Zhao Yun saved A Dou, and Zhang Fei held off a host with one roar and one boulder.
tut.s.jang-bi.done2: Cut the road with the time a roar buys, and the enemy can't follow.
tut.s.jang-bi.say1: Who is that warrior? Hold your arrows — take him alive!
tut.s.jang-bi.say2: I carry my lord's son. Whoever blocks my path will be cut down!
tut.s.jang-bi.say3: Zhao Yun, well done getting this far. Leave the rest to me!
tut.s.jang-bi.say4: I am Zhang Yide of Yan! Who will fight me to the death?
tut.s.jang-bi.say5: My ears, my ears… I can't breathe…!
tut.s.jang-bi.say6: My lord, I have brought young master A Dou back safely.
tut.s.jang-bi.say7: Over this one little child, I nearly lost a great general!
tut.s.jang-bi.say8: My lord… even if this Zhao Yun spilled his life on the ground, I could never repay this.
tut.s.jang-hap.intro: Jieting, the pass from Hanzhong to Guanzhong — Zhuge Liang's northern campaign hangs on it.
tut.s.jang-hap.camp: Ma Su has abandoned the water and camped on the hilltop.
tut.s.jang-hap.intro2: Cut off from water, Shu's troops rush down the hill at Zhang He.
tut.s.jang-hap.skill: 「Byeon-hwa-mu-ssang」 — For 3.9 days, strike back at any range when attacked.
tut.s.jang-hap.wait: Let the enemy come. Every strike they make is returned.
tut.s.jang-hap.done: The swarming Shu troops collapsed on their own. Having lost Jieting, Shu withdraws.
tut.s.jang-hap.done2: The more enemies surround you, the stronger your counterattacks.
tut.s.jang-hap.say1: The art of war says: from high ground, one looks down upon the foe!
tut.s.jang-hap.say2: He's abandoned the water. The men on that hill won't last three days.
tut.s.jang-hap.say3: General, they're coming down! Shouldn't we go out to meet them?
tut.s.jang-hap.say4: Let them come. Let them swing their swords first.
tut.s.jang-hap.say5: Didn't I tell you to camp by the water!
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.intro: Red Cliffs. The southeast wind Zhuge Liang prayed for at the Seven Stars Altar begins to blow.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.intro2: Feigning surrender, Huang Gai steers fire ships toward Cao Cao's fleet.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.sail: Sail Huang Gai up to Cao Cao's fleet.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.ignite: End the turn with [Wait] and the fire ships will ignite.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.fire: Flames engulf Cao Cao's fleet! Officers on fire lose 2 HP each day.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.skill2: Use Huang Gai's unique skill. His turn remains after using it.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.brawl: Three against five. Fight on with damage halved.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.wind: Zhuge Liang's 「Cha-dong-pung」 lets a unique skill be used twice.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.gust: The wind from the Seven Stars Altar grows fierce, and the officers' spirit revives.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.again: 「Yong-maeng-jeon-jin」 is ready again. Have all three use it once more.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.escape: With the wind borrowed, it's time for Zhuge Liang to leave. Go to the buoy.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.done: Riding the southeast wind, the fire swallowed Cao Cao's fleet as Zhuge Liang calmly left the river.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.done2: Cha-dong-pung lets a used unique skill be used again. Save it for the decisive one.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say1: The wind has come! Gongfu, set Cao Cao's ships ablaze!
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say2: Cao Cao, you cur! Taste the fire of Huang Gongfu!
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say3: Fire! Cut down that old man first! Let none escape!
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say4: Tell Ding Feng: Zhuge Liang at the Seven Stars Altar must not live. He'll threaten Wu one day.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say5: Zhuge Liang! By the Commander's order, halt!
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say6: Strategist, I've come by our lord's order to escort you.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say7: Ah, Zilong. Let us go — give my regards to the Commander.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say8: Zhao Zilong of Changshan… I can't pursue him.
tut.s.je-gal-ryang.say9: Well then, I'd best be off before the Grand Commander catches me.
tut.s.jo-un.intro: Changban. Clutching A Dou, Zhao Yun stands amid Cao Cao's great host.
tut.s.jo-un.intro2: Break through to the buoy and you reach Liu Bei's camp.
tut.s.jo-un.skill: 「Gan-noe-do-ji」 — For 3.9 days, every attack is a Critical and damage taken is halved.
tut.s.jo-un.delay: Gathering momentum takes time. This turn ends; the effect starts next turn.
tut.s.jo-un.eun: Xiahou En, bearing the Qinggang Blade, blocks the way.
tut.s.jo-un.cut: [Attack]! With a Critical, one stroke cuts him down.
tut.s.jo-un.block: Li Dian bars the way. Close in, cut him down, and pass.
tut.s.jo-un.cut2: [Attack]! Surrounding enemies deal only half damage.
tut.s.jo-un.open: The way is open! Race south.
tut.s.jo-un.last: 「Gan-noe-do-ji」 has worn off, but the way is open. To the buoy!
tut.s.jo-un.done: Holding A Dou, Zhao Yun broke through the encirclement at Changban.
tut.s.jo-un.done2: While momentum lasts, pierce the deepest point. When it's spent, all that's left is to run.
tut.s.jo-un.say1: Young master, bear with me a little longer. I, Zilong, will surely bring you to our lord.
tut.s.jo-un.say2: Halt! Think you'll leave alive before this Qinggang Blade?
tut.s.jo-un.say3: The Qinggang Blade… a fine sword. It's mine now.
tut.s.jo-un.say4: My lord, young master A Dou is safe.
tut.s.ju-yu.intro: Wu's camp, the eve of Red Cliffs. Cai Mao and Zhang Yun's marines have crept up to Huang Gai.
tut.s.ju-yu.intro2: Zhou Yu and Huang Gai have a plan: before the enemy, they'll pretend to quarrel.
tut.s.ju-yu.skill: 「Go-yuk-ji-chaek」 — Pick an ally as partner. Each turn after, Zhou Yu may choose to strike them.
tut.s.ju-yu.skill2: Use the unique skill and choose Huang Gai.
tut.s.ju-yu.ask: Choose “Yes” at “Strike an ally?” and Zhou Yu hits Huang Gai at any range (normal hit).
tut.s.ju-yu.ask2: Once struck, Huang Gai gets Critical 100% for 1 day, and enemies can't target him.
tut.s.ju-yu.buffed: Huang Gai bleeds from the beating — yet the enemy can't turn a blade on him.
tut.s.ju-yu.cut: Huang Gai's turn. Cut down Cai Mao with a Critical.
tut.s.ju-yu.again: Once more — choose “Yes” and strike Huang Gai.
tut.s.ju-yu.visit: Then — Cao Cao's envoy Jiang Gan arrives at Zhou Yu's tent with a jug of wine.
tut.s.ju-yu.no: This time, “No” — Zhou Yu strikes Jiang Gan himself.
tut.s.ju-yu.done: Thinking their foes were fighting each other, Cao Cao's troops fell without lifting a hand.
tut.s.ju-yu.done2: Go-yuk-ji-chaek gains power by striking an ally. Choose each turn — and don't hit too hard.
tut.s.ju-yu.say1: Quiet… the men of Wu don't know we're here yet.
tut.s.ju-yu.say2: Huang Gai! You speak of surrender in my camp? You'll answer for defying military law!
tut.s.ju-yu.say3: Does a green commander dare scorn an old general?
tut.s.ju-yu.say5: What's this… they're fighting among themselves?
tut.s.ju-yu.say6: What's going on? Our blades can't reach that old man!
tut.s.ju-yu.say7: Gongjin, it's been a while. The night is late — a drink? And how are things in your camp?
tut.s.ju-yu.say8: Commander, that flogging really stung. Ha ha.
tut.s.ju-yu.say9: Gongfu, I, Zhou Yu, will never forget your wounds.
tut.s.ju-yu.say10: An old friend, you say? You care more for my camp than the wine. Did you think I wouldn't see it?
tut.s.ju-yu.say11: Wh-what… Gongjin saw through it all! Retreat!
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.intro: Beihai. Guan Hai's Yellow Turbans have the city surrounded.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.intro2: Guan Hai, before the gate, targets Kong Rong. Exhausted, Kong Rong can't take a single blow.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.skill: 「So-pae-wang-jeon」 — Pick one enemy. Until one of you falls, you can only strike each other.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.skill2: Use the unique skill and choose Guan Hai.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.ride: Break through the siege and ride to Guan Hai's side.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.attack: [Attack]! Now Guan Hai's spear points only at Taishi Ci.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.duel: Guan Hai can't strike Kong Rong. It's a one-on-one duel.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.duel2: Defeat Guan Hai before the Yellow Turbans come down.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.done: Taishi Ci cut down Guan Hai and the Yellow Turbans scattered. Beihai is saved.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.done2: When someone you protect is targeted, bind that foe into a duel with you.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.say1: Ziyi, you came! The city can't hold much longer.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.say2: My mother bade me repay your kindness. Leave Guan Hai to me.
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.say3: Where'd you crawl out from? Fine, I'll cut you down first!
tut.s.tae-sa-ja.say4: Ziyi, you are truly a man of honor.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.intro: Xiapi. Lü Bu's officers block Xiahou Dun as he marches against Lü Bu.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.intro2: Then an arrow from Cao Xing pierces Xiahou Dun's left eye.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.arrow: “I can't throw away what my parents gave me!” Xiahou Dun pulls the arrow and swallows the eye.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.skill: 「Bal-si-dam-jeong」 — Xiahou Dun takes half damage for 4.9 days.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.fight: The enemy swarms Xiahou Dun. He takes only half damage.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.done: The one-eyed warrior tore through the siege. Cao Xing fell by his hand too.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.done2: When surrounded, use your survival skill first. Stay standing and you can strike back.
tut.s.ha-hu-don.say1: A hit! I hit Xiahou Dun's eye!
tut.s.ha-hu-don.say3: Hold the line! Think one eye will bring down Xiahou Yuanrang?
tut.s.ha-hu-don.say4: Cao Xing, I've collected the price of your arrow.
tut.s.heo-jeo.wi: The Wei River crosses Guanzhong into the Yellow River. Here Cao Cao faces Ma Chao and Han Sui.
tut.s.heo-jeo.intro: As Cao Cao crossed the stream to board a boat, Ma Chao's Xiliang cavalry gave chase.
tut.s.heo-jeo.intro2: Bring Cao Cao to the ferry, marked by a buoy.
tut.s.heo-jeo.skill: 「Dan-gi-do-gang」 — For 2.9 days, allies near Xu Chu take half damage.
tut.s.heo-jeo.guard: Xu Chu stands by Cao Cao. Press [Wait].
tut.s.heo-jeo.run: Cao Cao runs for the ferry. He can only move one square at a time.
tut.s.heo-jeo.block: Xu Chu crosses the stream one step ahead of Cao Cao.
tut.s.heo-jeo.wait: Check that Cao Cao is within 1 square. Then [Wait].
tut.s.heo-jeo.around: Pass beside Xu Chu and climb toward the ferry.
tut.s.heo-jeo.board: The ferry is right ahead. Get on the boat!
tut.s.heo-jeo.done: Xu Chu shielded arrows with a saddle, and Cao Cao crossed the river.
tut.s.heo-jeo.done2: Stick close to whoever you must protect. An aura breaks once you drift apart.
tut.s.heo-jeo.say1: Zhongkang, Ma Chao's cavalry is too fast!
tut.s.heo-jeo.say2: My lord, stay by my side. I'll block every arrow.
tut.s.heo-jeo.say3: Don't let Cao Cao escape! Stop that boat!
tut.s.heo-jeo.say4: Without Zhongkang, I'd be at the bottom of the river today.
tut.s.hwang-chung.intro: Mount Dingjun. Xiahou Yuan is camped deep on the mountain, three officers guarding him.
tut.s.hwang-chung.intro2: Fa Zheng waves a flag from the ridge. “Now, old general!”
tut.s.hwang-chung.skill: 「Baek-bo-cheon-yang」 — For 2.9 days, shoot any enemy on the map, and every attack is a Critical.
tut.s.hwang-chung.delay: Drawing the bow takes time. This turn ends; the effect starts next turn.
tut.s.hwang-chung.aim: The bow is fully drawn. Xiahou Yuan, beyond his guards, is now in range.
tut.s.hwang-chung.wait: Fa Zheng holds the flag on the ridge. Press [Wait].
tut.s.hwang-chung.again: One more shot! Shoot Xiahou Yuan again before the bow cools.
tut.s.hwang-chung.done: He can pierce a willow leaf a hundred paces off. Xiahou Yuan has fallen.
tut.s.hwang-chung.done2: If the way is blocked, don't go around — aim for the leader beyond it.
tut.s.hwang-chung.say1: An old man climbing the mountain? Can he even draw a bowstring?
tut.s.hwang-chung.say2: Old, am I? I'll show you whether this bow has grown old!
tut.s.hwang-chung.say3: One arrow from the old general has won Mount Dingjun!
